- Before switch: robots should be STATIONARY (score += 1 per moving robot)
- After switch: robots should be MOVING (score += 1 per stationary robot)
- Green wall lights up at switch time → robots should detect green (color 2) and start moving

The ideal machine would: Stop by default, then when green is seen (color 2), switch to GoToColor(green) or Exploration.

The champion likely works because robots quickly move to Stop state and stay there, then the Exploration provides movement after the switch.

- Before switch: Stop (minimize moving robots)
- After switch: move (green wall visible → GoToColor green or Exploration)
